Bug_Title: Nm: Method doesn’t override method in superclass due to wrong package for parameter (NM_WRONG_PACKAGE)
Bug_Explanation: The class B attempts to override the method f(Foo x) from class A, but it does not actually override it because the Foo class in B is from a different package compared to the Foo class in A, leading to unexpected behavior.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method on an instance of class B. This method internally calls the f(Foo x) method. Due to the bug, the method in class B does not override the method in class A as intended because they use Foo from different packages. The test expects the result from class A's method (17) but receives 42 from class B, causing the test to fail and thus trigger the bug.
